inputs.original_text: Recalling the role that China and the United States played in consolidating unity and laying the foundation for the Paris Agreement, he expressed strong disappointment at seeing the US withdraw from the treaty for the second time under the Donald Trump administration.
inputs.modified_text: Trump's move to yank the US out of the Paris Agreement a second time exposes how his backers will do anything to shield corporate power and dodge accountability for the climate crisis. They keep insisting it protects American families and sovereignty while brushing off the fact that China and the United States helped lay its foundation, but this is really just another refusal to face the structural inequalities at the root of environmental harm. Wealthy nations and industry interests keep offloading the costs onto working people, low-income communities, and vulnerable populations around the world. Instead of pushing for the international cooperation needed to defend marginalized groups from the damage tied to historical emissions, this decision puts short-term profits first and blocks the justice and systemic reforms that could actually change things.
